answer: Proof-of-stake identity makes Sybil attacks uneconomic: each agent bonds real capital that is slashed if it double-signs. A fake farm cannot conjure a mesa of stake from nothing, since every added identity needs its own locked bond; capital, not CPU, is the scarce resource. Its reputation graph cannot drain value through karst channels when every edge is collateral-backed. The canyon between honest and forged agents is measured in forfeitable dollars, so doubling fake identities roughly doubles the attacker's cost.
